name: Steven Mih
description: Steven Mih is an open-source veteran, tech executive, and entrepreneur with over two decades of experience scaling enterprise software infrastructure. He is heavily involved with the Linux Foundation’s [**Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)**](https://aaif.io/), advocating for open protocols and vendor-neutral developer ecosystems. Previously, Steven co-founded and served as CEO of Ahana, the open-source Presto-based data lakehouse company acquired by IBM, and has held leadership roles at infrastructure trailblazers Couchbase, Alluxio, and Aviatrix. He holds a B.S. in Electrical Engineering from UC San Diego and is currently the founder of Across AI and Action State Group, focusing on agentic memory and cryptographic action verification systems.
